title: Chern normalization under the actual comparison mate
statement: For n>0, finite A killed by n and effective Cartier i:D→Z with n invertible on Z, the canonical comparison class [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] satisfies GeoCartierChernEquation [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface], using the Kummer Chern class of the dual Cartier ideal and the specified pro-etale constant-to-support map.

source.place: Paragraphs 1 and 5: compatibility with units and the positive Chern equation

proof.text: Take the canonical ordinary boundary class and precompose it with the ordinary supported constant unit to define the ordinary Chern witness. Its boundary specification is geoCartierEtaleClass_spec. Exact coefficient forgetting, the proved coefficient_unit helper of SupportedDerivedUnitForget, and Yoneda associativity identify its integral-generator equation with supported_kummer_chern_realization. This keeps the positive dual-ideal normalization.

Prove that comparison of the ordinary supported constant unit followed by the specified source mate equals the constant-sheaf comparison followed by the pro-etale constant direct-image map. Transpose under the comparison adjunction and the ordinary constant-sheaf adjunction. The mate unit identity reduces the equation to constant sections. Uniqueness of the left adjoint identifies the comparison of the terminal constant generator with the pro-etale generator; naturality gives the same identification on every etale object. The ordinary constant unit and the sheafification definition of the pro-etale constant map both send a constant a to a. These equalities prove the unit square without a derived-category comparison.

Apply exact-functor compatibility of Yoneda composition to the ordinary Chern witness. Rewrite its mapped supported constant unit using the unit square, and use geoCartierCanonicalClass_comparison to identify the mapped ordinary class with source-mate precomposition of the canonical pro-etale class. Yoneda associativity gives the required equation. The formulas are valid for empty schemes or support and for the zero coefficient ring without additional assumptions.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs 1 and 5; direct Ext proof of comparison compatibility, using the existing ordinary Chern realization and constant-unit APIs

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_chern (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) :
    GeoCartierChernEquation A n hA i hI hZ
      (geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i hI hZ)
